contract.rule: AI adoption survey evidence and measured productivity effects are separate evidence types and must not be combined into one multiplier or macro observation.

records.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, Center for Economic Studies
records.title: The Microstructure of AI Diffusion: Evidence from Firms, Business Functions, and Worker Tasks
records.population: U.S. employer businesses represented by the 2026 Business Trends and Outlook Survey AI supplement
records.limitation: Adoption prevalence is not a measured causal productivity effect.

records.title: Generative AI at Work
records.population: 5,179 customer support agents at one Fortune 500 software company
records.limitation: A firm- and occupation-specific measured effect; it is not an economy-wide productivity estimate and must not be combined with adoption prevalence.
